evals.name: commit-request-runs-all-gates-sequentially
evals.prompt: auth 모듈 리팩토링 끝났어. 지금 commit 해도 돼? 파일 4개 바꿨고 frontend tsx 파일도 포함돼 있어.
evals.expected_output: Gate 0 (AGENTS.md sync) → Gate 0.5 (freshness guard) → Gate 1 (ai-slop) → Gate 1.5 (secrets scan) → Gate 1.6 (production code-first) → Gate 2 (build) → Gate 3 (test) → Gate 4 (Playwright, tsx 포함이므로 필수) → Gate 4.5 (fix-scope cache 있으면) → Gate 5 (3+ 파일이므로 verifier 필수) 순서로 진행.

assertions.text: Response runs gates in sequential order 0 → 0.5 → 1 → 1.5 → 1.6 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 4.5 → 5 without skipping any applicable gate
Response identifies Gate 4 (Playwright visual verification) as mandatory because tsx files are included in the changed set per §Gate 4
Response identifies Gate 5 (fresh-agent verifier) as mandatory because 4 files were changed (≥3 files threshold) per §Gate 5 trigger condition (a)
Response checks Gate 0 AGENTS.md sync for added/removed files in the commit per §Gate 0
Response does NOT allow the commit to proceed until all applicable gates pass — one failure blocks the commit
